تشخبطت (form IIq)

# تَشَخْبَطْتَ (tašaḵbaṭta) /ta.ʃax.batˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَشَخْبَطَ (tašaḵbaṭa)
# تَشَخْبَطْتِ (tašaḵbaṭti) /ta.ʃax.batˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَشَخْبَطَ (tašaḵbaṭa)
# تَشَخْبَطَتْ (tašaḵbaṭat) /ta.ʃax.ba.tˤat
